about: Real-world detection cases (docs/INVESTIGATION_2026-11-08.md). Every confirmed failure becomes a case. Times are CLIP seconds of the capture's clip. truth: one row per chest opening (what: new_popup = a new pop-up appears, new_line = a chest line is added to a pop-up already on screen, multiplier = a line's X2/X3 changes) and per non-chest pop-up change that must NOT count (what: not_chest). type: chest | rare | sprite (the word on the line). Footage: research/cases.py fetch copies the needed segments into samples/cases/ (not in Git); tests/fixtures/popups/<case>.npz holds the pop-up box masks so tests/test_cases.py runs without footage. Cases with "video" instead of "capture" are windows of a plain recording under samples/ (times are video seconds). "v041_gap" pins what v0.4.0 does on a confirmed failure (tests/test_cases.py checks it exactly); remove it when a v0.4.1 change fixes the case, so the case then has to pass like every other.
